title: [finding] `WidgetInput.label` / `defaultValue` / `advanced` (`packages/types/src/widget.ts`) have no reader once `WidgetRegistry` stops copying them onto the retired `ComponentInput` keys — #7781's class, one face over
body:
## 维护者速读

第三方作者写的「小部件说明书」(widget manifest)里有三个键 —— `label`(输入项的标题)、`defaultValue`(默认值)、`advanced`(收进高级区)—— 本仓从 #7493 起**一个地方都不读**。以前有一条搬运线把它们抄到组件注册表上,#7493 把那条线连同它的落点一起退役了,于是这三个键在本仓成了「写了也不会发生任何事」。

⚠️ 这里有一半量不到:小部件说明书**按设计就在本仓之外编写**。本仓的零读数是实测的,但外面有没有人正在写这三个键、发布出去的 Zod 面接不接受它们,**没人量过**。

三个选择:

- **A —— 一起退役**:在小部件这一面也打上墓碑,作者写了会被响亮地拒绝。声明面从此只剩真有用的键;代价是如果外面真有说明书在写,它们升级时当场报错。
- **B —— 留着,并在文档块写明这是给外部作者看的说明书**:零风险,今天不动任何东西;代价是这三个键从此是永久义务,而且作者写了仍然什么都不会发生 —— 静默,不报错。
- **C —— 先量再裁**:派一张卡去补两个读数(发布出去的小部件说明书 Zod 面长什么样、真实说明书里有没有人在写这三个键),量完回来在 A / B 之间裁。

我的建议是 **C**:A 与 B 的代价差别完全取决于那个没量过的数,现在裁等于掷硬币。回退项是 **B** —— 它可逆,A 不可逆。

选哪个:A / B / C?

os-decision-facets

- ① 项目长远合理性:A 缩小声明面;B 把一个「声明了但没人兑现」的键永久化 —— 这类键每多一个,后面每一张同形态的卡都会拿它当先例。
- ② 实际业务拉动:本仓今天零人撞上(三个键零读者,实测,带同仪器的对照词);仓外有没有人撞上 ⛔ 未量 —— 这正是 C 要补的读数,也是 ② 现在给不出分数的原因。
- ③ 防 AI 犯错:B 是静默容忍 —— 作者或 AI 写下 `label`,发布通过,界面上什么都没变,没有任何人会看见这个错;A 是响亮拒绝 —— 写了当场报错,在发布前就被挡下。
- ④ 创业阶段不扩散:每一个已声明的键都是永久义务,remove 优于 declare-and-maintain;这一轴单独看指向 A。
- 推荐:**C**(回退:**B**)。
- 本分析看不见什么:我看不见本仓之外的小部件说明书 —— 有多少、谁在写、写了哪些键;也看不见 `WidgetManifest` 有没有已发布的 Zod 面。只要「外面真有人在写」成立,A 的代价就从零变成一次破坏性升级,答案会从「C 之后走 A」翻向 B。

## Measured on `origin/main` `6a9ee323`

`WidgetInput` (`packages/types/src/widget.ts:264-287`, the widget-manifest face) declares eight keys: `name`, `type`, `label`, `defaultValue`, `required`, `options`, `description`, `advanced`. Before the #7493 retirement, exactly ONE non-test site read `label`, `defaultValue` or `advanced` off a `WidgetInput`: `packages/core/src/registry/WidgetRegistry.ts:175-184`, which copied them onto the synthesized `ComponentInput` when syncing a loaded widget into the component registry. That copy was itself a write nothing read — the #7781 census — and the #7493 PR deletes it, because its targets are now `?: never` tombstones.

After that deletion the three `WidgetInput` members are declared-and-unread on their own face: receiver-shaped greps (`input.label` / `.defaultValue` / `.advanced` on a widget input, outside tests) return zero hits under `packages/**` and `apps/**`; `WidgetRegistry.load()` reads `name`, `type`, `required`, `options` and `description` only. Controls on the same instrument: `input.options` is read at the seam (`enum: input.options`), `input.type` at the seam and by the vocabulary pin `packages/types/src/__tests__/widget-input-control-vocabulary.test.ts`.

The `widget.ts` divergence docblock (its "Where this face still diverges from `ComponentInput`" section, item 2) is updated by the #7493 PR to record this state; it does not decide it.

## Not pre-judged

The same dispositions #7781 listed: retire on the widget face too (tombstone the three `WidgetInput` members — `?: never` and, if a Zod mirror exists for the widget manifest, `retirementTombstone()`), or keep them as deliberate widget-manifest documentation with a docblock saying so. Widget manifests are authored OUTSIDE this repository by design, so the in-repo zero is the measurable half only (the #5674 / #5905 limit). Whether `WidgetManifest` has a published Zod face and whether any widget manifest in the wild authors these keys are the facts a ruling needs.

Refs: #7493 · #7781 · #5905 · #5675 (the ruling that left this face's divergences recorded, not repaired).
